# Comparing p-tau217/AB42 to CSF using FDA cutoffs

#### Load libraries

```{r load libraries}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(pROC)
library(boot)
library(gtsummary)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(pROC)
library(see)
```

## 1. BioFINDER-Memory Clinic

------------------------------------------------------------------------

```{r set up data BF-MC}
#| echo: false
#| 
df <- read_xlsx("~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/Data/LP_PlasmaCSF_300625.xlsx")
df.val <- df %>% filter(df$Study %in% "VALIDATE")
df <- df.val #124

#change names etc.
names(df)[names(df) == "Plasma_Ptau217P_pgmL_Lumi"] <- "ptau217"
df$ptau217 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$ptau217))
names(df)[names(df) == "csf_clinical_routine_Abeta42_40_ratio_x10"] <- "csf_4240"
df$csf_4240 <- as.numeric(as.character(df$csf_4240))
df$csf_4240 <- df$csf_4240/10
#pass passing-bablok transformation for Lumipulse AB42 assay
df$Plasma_AB142_pgmL_Lumi_c <- 1.119 + 1.114*df$Plasma_AB142_pgmL_Lumi
df$PL_217_42 <- (df$ptau217)/(df$Plasma_AB142_pgmL_Lumi_c)

df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR_overall)
df <- df %>% select(sid_bf2, sid_diag, VR_overall, CL_fnc_ber_com_composite, csf_4240, ptau217, PL_217_42, Plasma_AB142_pgmL_Lumi_c, Plasma_AB142_pgmL_Lumi, PL_217_42_n, petstat)
df <- df %>% drop_na(csf_4240, ptau217)

```

### 2. Analyses VR FDA

```{r statistical analyses, AB-PET VR outcome}
##AUC differences with DeLong
biomarkers <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
 
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
        )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
                     file="~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/LP vs CSF/BioFINDER/Validate/FDA approach/DELONG_VR.xlsx")


df$petstat <- as.factor(df$VR_overall)
df <- df %>% drop_na(csf_4240)

df$ptau217_pos <- ifelse(df$ptau217 >= 0.23211, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217_neg <- ifelse(df$ptau217 <= 0.08681, 0, 1)

df$ptau217ab42_pos <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 >= 0.00738, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217ab42_neg <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 <= 0.00370, 0, 1)

df$ab4240_pos <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 <= 0.072, 1, 0)
df$ab4240_pos2 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 <= 0.058, 1, 0)

#Step 1: 1 cutoff

##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf, #27
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39
}   

set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

#Calculate pvalues 1 cutoff
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_1cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates <- boot_results$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

results_1cp_1 <- create_df(method_name = "Plasma p-tau217",boot_acc_index = 1,boot_ppv_index = 4,boot_npv_index = 7, boot_sen_index=19, boot_spec_index=22,boot_tp_index = 28, boot_fp_index=29, boot_tn_index=30, boot_fn_index=31)

results_1cp_2 <- create_df(method_name = "Plasma p-tau217/AB42",boot_acc_index = 2,boot_ppv_index = 5,boot_npv_index = 8, boot_sen_index=20, boot_spec_index=23,boot_tp_index = 32, boot_fp_index=33, boot_tn_index=34, boot_fn_index=35)

results_1cp_3 <- create_df(method_name = "CSF AB42/40",boot_acc_index = 3,boot_ppv_index = 6,boot_npv_index = 9, boot_sen_index=21, boot_spec_index=24,boot_tp_index = 36, boot_fp_index=37, boot_tn_index=38, boot_fn_index=39)

#Step 2: establish the intermediate zone

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217 = case_when(
    ptau217_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217ab42 = case_when(
    ptau217ab42_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217ab42_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ab4240 = case_when(
    ab4240_pos == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ab4240_pos2 == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

##Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217_pos", "ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217_neg", "ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos2")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217 <- length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42 <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_ptau217ab42
  diff_perc_ptau217_csf <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_csf
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217, int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf,
           diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42, diff_perc_ptau217_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_greyzone <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_greyzone, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalue %intermediate differences
stat_indices <- list("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42" = 4 , 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF" = 5, 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF" = 6)

pvals_intermediate <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42","Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF","Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_grey <- boot_results_greyzone$t

for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_greyzone$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217", "greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf,
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39)) #27
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,

  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_2cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_2cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add results to dataframe
create_df_2 <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index,boot_grey_index,boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = round(boot_results_greyzone$t0[boot_grey_index],3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "2 Cutpoints"
  )
}
```

### 2. Analyses CL 12 FDA

```{r statistical analyses, AB-PET VR outcome}

df$petstat <- as.factor(ifelse(df$CL_fnc_ber_com_composite >12, 1, 0))
df <- df %>% drop_na(petstat)
df <- df %>% drop_na(csf_4240)

##AUC differences with DeLong
biomarkers <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
 
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
        )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
                     file="~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/LP vs CSF/BioFINDER/Validate/FDA approach/Centiloids/DELONG_CL12.xlsx")

#Set cutoffs 
df$ptau217_pos <- ifelse(df$ptau217 >= 0.23211, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217_neg <- ifelse(df$ptau217 <= 0.08681, 0, 1)

df$ptau217ab42_pos <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 >= 0.00738, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217ab42_neg <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 <= 0.00370, 0, 1)

df$ab4240_pos2 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 <= 0.058, 1, 0)
df$ab4240_pos <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 <= 0.072, 1, 0)

#Step 1: 1 cutoff

##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf, #27
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39
}   

set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

#Calculate pvalues 1 cutoff
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_1cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates <- boot_results$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

results_1cp_1 <- create_df(method_name = "Plasma p-tau217",boot_acc_index = 1,boot_ppv_index = 4,boot_npv_index = 7, boot_sen_index=19, boot_spec_index=22,boot_tp_index = 28, boot_fp_index=29, boot_tn_index=30, boot_fn_index=31)

#Step 2: establish the intermediate zone

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217 = case_when(
    ptau217_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ptau217ab42 = case_when(
    ptau217ab42_neg == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ptau217ab42_pos == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(greyzone_ab4240 = case_when(
    ab4240_pos == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
    ab4240_pos2 == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
    TRUE ~ 2                     # Intermediate values
  ))

##Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217_pos", "ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217_neg", "ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos2")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217 <- length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42 <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_ptau217ab42
  diff_perc_ptau217_csf <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_csf
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217, int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf,
           diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42, diff_perc_ptau217_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_greyzone <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_greyzone, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalue %intermediate differences
stat_indices <- list("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42" = 4 , 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF" = 5, 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF" = 6)

pvals_intermediate <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42","Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF","Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_grey <- boot_results_greyzone$t

for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_greyzone$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217", "greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf,
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39)) #27
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_2cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_2 <- boot_results_2cp$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_2cp$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_2[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_2[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_2cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add results to dataframe
create_df_2 <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index,boot_grey_index,boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = round(boot_results_greyzone$t0[boot_grey_index],3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "2 Cutpoints"
  )
}
```

### 2. Analyses CL 24 FDA

```{r statistical analyses, AB-PET CL24}

df$petstat <- as.factor(ifelse(df$CL_fnc_ber_com_composite >= 24, 1, 0))
df <- df %>% drop_na(petstat)
df <- df %>% drop_na(csf_4240)

##AUC differences with DeLong
biomarkers <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
 
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
        )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
                     file="~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/LP vs CSF/BioFINDER/Validate/FDA approach/Centiloids/DELONG_CL24.xlsx")

#Set cutoffs 
df$ptau217_pos <- ifelse(df$ptau217 >= 0.23211, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217_neg <- ifelse(df$ptau217 <= 0.08681, 0, 1)

df$ptau217ab42_pos <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 >= 0.00738, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217ab42_neg <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 <= 0.00370, 0, 1)

df$ab4240_pos2 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 <= 0.058, 1, 0)
df$ab4240_pos <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 <= 0.072, 1, 0)

#Step 1: 1 cutoff

##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
  compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
    ##threshold calculation and 
    
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf, #27
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39
}   

set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

#Calculate pvalues 1 cutoff
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_1cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates <- boot_results$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

##Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  test_bio <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_pos <- c("ptau217_pos", "ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos2")
  pred_neg <- c("ptau217_neg", "ptau217ab42_neg", "ab4240_pos")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    neg_col <- pred_neg[i]
    pos_col <- pred_pos[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
        !!sym(neg_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
        !!sym(pos_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
        TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
  }
  
  int_n_ptau217 <- length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
  int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
  int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
  
  #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
  diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42 <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_ptau217ab42
  diff_perc_ptau217_csf <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_csf
  diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
  
  return(c(int_perc_ptau217, int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf,
           diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42, diff_perc_ptau217_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
}

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_greyzone <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_greyzone, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalue %intermediate differences
stat_indices <- list("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42" = 4 , 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF" = 5, 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF" = 6)

pvals_intermediate <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42","Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF","Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_grey <- boot_results_greyzone$t

for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_greyzone$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
  compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
    
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
  }
  
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217", "greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_pos","ptau217ab42_pos", "ab4240_pos")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2
  
  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf,
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39)) #27
} 

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs

pvals_2cp <- data.frame(

  pvals_2cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add results to dataframe
create_df_2 <- function(method_name, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index,boot_grey_index,boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    accuracy = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results_2cp$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results_2cp$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = round(boot_results_greyzone$t0[boot_grey_index],3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = round(quantile(boot_results_greyzone$t[, boot_grey_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "2 Cutpoints"
  )
}
```

### 2. Analyses VR

```{r statistical analyses, AB-PET VR outcome}
df <- df %>% drop_na(csf_4240)

df$ptau217_spec90_lumi <- ifelse(df$ptau217 > 0.253, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217_spec95_lumi <- ifelse(df$ptau217 > 0.320, 1, 0)
df$ptau217_sens95_lumi <- ifelse(df$ptau217 > 0.190, 1, 0)

df$ptau217ab42_spec90 <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 > 0.009, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217ab42_spec95 <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 > 0.011, 1, 0)
df$ptau217ab42_sens95 <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 > 0.007, 1, 0)

df$ab4240_spec90 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 < 0.054, 1, 0) 
df$ab4240_spec95 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 < 0.048, 1, 0)
df$ab4240_sens95 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 < 0.066, 1, 0)

#Step 1: 1 cutoff

##AUC differences with DeLong
biomarkers <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
 
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
        )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
                     file="~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/LP vs CSF/BioFINDER/Validate/Visual Read outcome/DELONG_VR.xlsx")


##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
   compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
     ##threshold calculation and 
     
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
   }

  test_columns <- c("ptau217_spec90_lumi","ptau217ab42_spec90", "ab4240_spec90")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2

  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf, #27
         tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, auc_index, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    auc = round(results_delong$auc_order[auc_index], 3),
    auc_ci_lower = round(quantile(results_delong$auc_order_ci_low[auc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    auc_ci_upper = round(quantile(results_delong$auc_order_ci_high[auc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

##Function to bootstrap %intermediate
f_greyzone <- function(data, indices){
  d <- data[indices, ]
    
  test_bio <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_ab4240")
  pred_sens95 <- c("ptau217_sens95_lumi", "ptau217ab42_sens95", "ab4240_sens95")
  pred_spec95 <- c("ptau217_spec95_lumi", "ptau217ab42_spec95", "ab4240_spec95")

  for (i in seq_along(test_bio)) {
    greyzone_col <- paste0("greyzone_", test_bio[i])
    sens95_col <- pred_sens95[i]
    spec95_col <- pred_spec95[i]
    
    d <- d %>%
        mutate(!!greyzone_col := case_when(
      !!sym(sens95_col) == 0 ~ 1,  # sens95 equals 0
      !!sym(spec95_col) == 1 ~ 3,  # spec95 equals 1
      TRUE ~ 2
      ))  
    }

    int_n_ptau217 <- length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 ==2))
    int_perc_ptau217 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ptau217 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
    
    int_n_ptau217ab42 <- length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 ==2))
    int_perc_ptau217ab42 <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_PL_217_42 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
    
    int_n_csf <- length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 ==2))
    int_perc_csf <- round((length(which(d$greyzone_ab4240 == 2)) / nrow(d)) * 100, 3)
    
    #DIFFERENCES BETWEEN ASSAYS
    diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42 <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_ptau217ab42
    diff_perc_ptau217_csf <- int_perc_ptau217 - int_perc_csf
    diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf <- int_perc_ptau217ab42 - int_perc_csf
    
    return(c(int_perc_ptau217, int_perc_ptau217ab42,int_perc_csf,
             diff_perc_ptau217_ptau217ab42, diff_perc_ptau217_csf, diff_perc_ptau217ab42_csf))
  }

set.seed(12345)
boot_results_greyzone <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_greyzone, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalue %intermediate differences
stat_indices <- list("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42" = 4 , 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF" = 5, 
                     "Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF" = 6)

pvals_intermediate <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Int% pval p-tau217 vs. p-tau217/AB42","Int% pval p-tau217 vs. CSF","Int% pval p-tau217/AB42 vs.CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_grey <- boot_results_greyzone$t

for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_greyzone$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_grey[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_intermediate[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

#Step 3: Two cutoff approach

f_comp_stats_2cp <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  
   compute_metrics <- function(d,greyzone, true, pred) {
     
    dx <- d %>% filter(!!sym(greyzone) != 2)
    
    v_tp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 0 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(dx[[true]] == 1 & dx[[pred]] == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
   }
   
  greyzones <- c("greyzone_ptau217", "greyzone_ptau217ab42","greyzone_ab4240")
  test_columns <- c("ptau217_spec90_lumi","ptau217ab42_spec90", "ab4240_spec90")
  true_label <- "petstat"
  
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol =9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d, greyzone = greyzones[i], true = true_label, pred = test_columns[i]),3)
  }
  
  #P-tau217
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #P-tau217/AB42
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #CSF
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2

  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf,
           tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39)) #27
} 
  
set.seed(12345)
boot_results_2cp <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats_2cp, R = 2000)

##Calculate pvalues two cutoffs
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_2cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates_2 <- boot_results_2cp$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results_2cp$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates_2[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates_2[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_2cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

  )

  PPV = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", merged_comps_bf$PPV, merged_comps_bf$ppv_ci_lower, merged_comps_bf$ppv_ci_upper),
  NPV = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", merged_comps_bf$NPV, merged_comps_bf$npv_ci_lower, merged_comps_bf$npv_ci_upper),
  AUC= sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", merged_comps_bf$auc, merged_comps_bf$auc_ci_lower, merged_comps_bf$auc_ci_upper),
  Gre= sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", merged_comps_bf$intermediate_n_percentage, merged_comps_bf$intermediate_n_percentage_low, merged_comps_bf$intermediate_n_percentage_high),
  Sensitivity = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", merged_comps_bf$Sensitivity, merged_comps_bf$sen_ci_lower, merged_comps_bf$sen_ci_upper),
  Specificity =sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", merged_comps_bf$Specificity, merged_comps_bf$spec_ci_lower, merged_comps_bf$spec_ci_upper))

openxlsx::write.xlsx(table_df,file="~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/LP vs CSF/BioFINDER/Validate/Visual Read outcome/BF_results_90spec_table.xlsx", rowNames =T)
```

### 1. Plots to examine data CL

#### 1a. Correlation plots CL

```{r boxplots CL}
#| echo: false
df$petstat <- as.factor(df$petstat)

ggplot(df, aes(x = CL_fnc_ber_com_composite, y = ptau217)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, shape = 20, alpha = 0.85, color="#ab123a") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#ab123a", fill = "#ab123a") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=24, linetype="dotted", color="black", alpha=0.9)+
  labs(x = "AB-PET (Centiloids)", y = "Plasma p-tau217") +
```

```{r statistical analyses, AB-PET CL outcome}
df <- df %>% drop_na(csf_4240)

df$ptau217_spec90_lumi <- ifelse(df$ptau217 > 0.23, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217_spec95_lumi <- ifelse(df$ptau217 > 0.43, 1, 0)
df$ptau217_sens95_lumi <- ifelse(df$ptau217 > 0.21, 1, 0)

df$ptau217ab42_spec90 <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 > 0.007, 1, 0) 
df$ptau217ab42_spec95 <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 > 0.015, 1, 0)
df$ptau217ab42_sens95 <- ifelse(df$PL_217_42 > 0.007, 1, 0)

df$ab4240_spec90 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 < 0.056, 1, 0) 
df$ab4240_spec95 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 < 0.044, 1, 0)
df$ab4240_sens95 <- ifelse(df$csf_4240 < 0.068, 1, 0)

#Step 1: 1 cutoff

##AUC differences with DeLong
biomarkers <- c("ptau217","PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
results_delong <- list()
index <- 1

for (i in seq_along(biomarkers)){
  for (j in seq_along(biomarkers)){ 
    if (i < j) {
      predictor1 <- biomarkers[i]
      predictor2 <- biomarkers[j]
 
      formula1 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor1, collapse=""))
      formula2 <- as.formula(paste("petstat~",predictor2, collapse=""))
      
      roc_curve1 <- pROC::roc(formula1, data=df, quiet=T)
      roc_curve2 <- pROC::roc(formula2, data=df,quiet=T)
      
      res <- roc.test(roc_curve1, roc_curve2, method = "delong")
      
      long <- data.frame(
        comp = paste(predictor1, predictor2, sep=" vs. "),
        auc1a = round(roc_curve1$auc,3),
        auc2a = round(roc_curve2$auc,3),
        pval = round(res$p.value,3),
        auc1_ci_low = round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[1],3),
        auc1_ci_high =round(ci.auc(roc_curve1)[3],3),
        auc2_ci_low =round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[1],3),
        auc2_ci_high = round(ci.auc(roc_curve2)[3],3)
        )
      
      results_delong[[length(results_delong) + 1]] <- long
      index <- index + 1
    }
  }
}

results_delong <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, results_delong)
results_delong$padj <- round(p.adjust(results_delong$pval, method = "fdr"),3)
results_delong$auc_order <- c(results_delong$auc1a[1],results_delong$auc1a[3], results_delong$auc2a[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_low <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_low[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_low[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_low[3])
results_delong$auc_order_ci_high <- c(results_delong$auc1_ci_high[1],results_delong$auc1_ci_high[3], results_delong$auc2_ci_high[3])
openxlsx::write.xlsx(results_delong,
                     file="~/Documents/Projects/LP vs CSF/LP vs CSF/BioFINDER/Validate/Centiloids outcome/DELONG_CL24.xlsx")


##Calculate Accuracy, PPV, NPV and 95% CIs

f_comp_stats <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- as.data.frame(data[indices,])
  
  ##threshold calculation related to d, and then assign binary status based on that threshold
   compute_metrics <- function(true, pred) {
    
     ##threshold calculation and 
     
    v_tp <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 1)
    v_fp <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 1)
    v_tn <- sum(true == 0 & pred == 0)
    v_fn <- sum(true == 1 & pred == 0)
    
    sens <- v_tp / (v_tp + v_fn)
    spec <- v_tn / (v_tn + v_fp)
    acc <- (v_tp + v_tn) / (v_tp + v_tn + v_fn + v_fp)
    ppv <- cutpointr::ppv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    npv <- cutpointr::npv(tp = v_tp, fp = v_fp, tn = v_tn, fn = v_fn)
    
    return(c(acc, ppv, npv, sens, spec, v_tp, v_fp, v_tn, v_fn))#sens#spec
   }

  test_columns <- c("ptau217_spec90_lumi","ptau217ab42_spec90", "ab4240_spec90")
  results <- matrix(nrow = length(test_columns), ncol = 9)
  colnames(results) <- c("Accuracy", "PPV", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN")
  rownames(results) <- c("ptau217", "PL_217_42", "csf_4240")
  
  for (i in seq_along(test_columns)) {
    results[i, ] <- round(compute_metrics(d$petstat, d[[test_columns[i]]]),3)
  }
  
  #Assign p-tau217 metrics
  acc1 <- results[1,1]
  ppv1 <- results[1,2]
  npv1 <- results[1,3]
  sens1 <- results[1,4]
  spec1 <- results[1,5]
  tp1 <- results[1,6]
  fp1 <- results[1,7]
  tn1 <- results[1,8]
  fn1 <- results[1,9]
  
  #Assign p-tau217/AB42 metrics
  acc2 <- results[2,1]
  ppv2 <- results[2,2]
  npv2 <- results[2,3]
  sens2 <- results[2,4]
  spec2 <- results[2,5]
  tp2 <- results[2,6]
  fp2 <- results[2,7]
  tn2 <- results[2,8]
  fn2 <- results[2,9]
  
  #Assign CSF metrics
  acc3 <- results[3,1]
  ppv3 <- results[3,2]
  npv3 <- results[3,3]
  sens3 <- results[3,4]
  spec3 <- results[3,5]
  tp3 <- results[3,6]
  fp3 <- results[3,7]
  tn3 <- results[3,8]
  fn3 <- results[3,9]
  
  #p-tau217 vs. 217/ab42
  diff_acc_217_217ab42 <- acc1 - acc2
  diff_ppv_217_217ab42 <- ppv1 - ppv2
  diff_npv_217_217ab42 <- npv1 - npv2
  diff_sens_217_217ab42 <- sens1 - sens2

  #p-tau217 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217_csf <- acc1 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217_csf <- ppv1 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217_csf <- npv1 - npv3
  diff_sens_217_csf <- sens1 - sens3
  
  #217/ab42 vs. CSF
  diff_acc_217ab42_csf <- acc2 - acc3
  diff_ppv_217ab42_csf <- ppv2 - ppv3
  diff_npv_217ab42_csf <- npv2 - npv3
  diff_sens_217ab42_csf <- sens2 - sens3
  
  return(c(acc1, acc2, acc3, ppv1, ppv2, ppv3, npv1, npv2, npv3,#9
           diff_acc_217_217ab42, diff_ppv_217_217ab42, diff_npv_217_217ab42,#12
           diff_acc_217_csf,diff_ppv_217_csf,diff_npv_217_csf, #15
           diff_acc_217ab42_csf, diff_ppv_217ab42_csf,diff_npv_217ab42_csf,#18
           sens1, sens2, sens3, spec1, spec2, spec3, #24
           diff_sens_217_217ab42,diff_sens_217_csf, diff_sens_217ab42_csf, #27
         tp1, fp1, tn1, fn1, tp2, fp2, tn2, fn2, tp3, fp3, tn3, fn3)) #31 #35 #39
}   
  
set.seed(12345)
boot_results <- boot(data = df, statistic = f_comp_stats, R = 2000)

#Calculate pvalues 1 cutoff
stat_indices <- list(
  "Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 10,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 11,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42" = 12,
  "Accuracy 217 vs. CSF" = 13,
  "PPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 14,
  "NPV pval 217 vs. CSF" = 15,
  "Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 16,
  "PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 17,
  "NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF" = 18)

pvals_1cp <- data.frame(
  Pval = numeric(length(stat_indices)),
  row.names = c("Accuracy 217 vs. 217_AB42","PPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","NPV pval 217 vs. 217_AB42","Accuracy 217 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217 vs. CSF","Accuracy 217ab42 vs. CSF","PPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF","NPV pval 217ab42 vs. CSF"))

bootstrap_replicates <- boot_results$t
for (stat_name in names(stat_indices)) {
  index <- stat_indices[[stat_name]]
  boot_diff <- boot_results$t0[index]
  results_underH0_diff <- bootstrap_replicates[, index] - mean(bootstrap_replicates[, index])
  p_value <- mean(abs(results_underH0_diff) >= abs(boot_diff))
  pvals_1cp[paste0(stat_name), "Pval"] <- round(p_value, 3)
}

##Add outcomes to dataframe (function to establish dataframe as desired)
create_df <- function(method_name, auc_index, boot_acc_index, boot_ppv_index, boot_npv_index, boot_sen_index, boot_spec_index,boot_tp_index,boot_fp_index,boot_tn_index,boot_fn_index) {
  data.frame(
    method = method_name,
    auc = round(results_delong$auc_order[auc_index], 3),
    auc_ci_lower = round(quantile(results_delong$auc_order_ci_low[auc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    auc_ci_upper = round(quantile(results_delong$auc_order_ci_high[auc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    accuracy = round(boot_results$t0[boot_acc_index], 3),
    acc_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    acc_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_acc_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    PPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_ppv_index], 3),
    ppv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    ppv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_ppv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    NPV = round(boot_results$t0[boot_npv_index], 3),
    npv_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    npv_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_npv_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Sensitivity =round(boot_results$t0[boot_sen_index], 3),
    sen_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    sen_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_sen_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    Specificity = round(boot_results$t0[boot_spec_index], 3),
    spec_ci_lower = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[1], 3),
    spec_ci_upper = round(quantile(boot_results$t[, boot_spec_index], c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm=T)[2], 3),
    TP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tp_index], 0),
    FP = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fp_index], 0),
    TN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_tn_index], 0),
    FN = round(boot_results$t0[boot_fn_index], 0),
    intermediate_n_percentage = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_low = NA,
    intermediate_n_percentage_high = NA,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    row.names = "1 Cutpoint"
  )
}

results_1cp_1 <- create_df(method_name = "Plasma p-tau217",auc_index = 1,boot_acc_index = 1,boot_ppv_index = 4,boot_npv_index = 7, boot_sen_index=19, boot_spec_index=22,boot_tp_index = 28, boot_fp_index=29, boot_tn_index=30, boot_fn_index=31)
```
